name: smwgraphics-castlevania-rondo-of-blood-merman
title: Castlevania: Rondo of Blood - Merman
description:
A Castlevania-themed reskin for the Basilisk sprite. The better place to use these sprites are dark sewers or castle levels, in general. Any dark setting or Castlevania setting is good enough.

You will need to edit the cfg file of the sprite to use palette A.

Credits to my friend, Dark Prince.
